source_faithful_kernel.compression_guard: Profile compression is allowed only at the final response. No terminal-only K19/K20 charge/profile or exact-zero-omitting profile is prolonged.
source_faithful_kernel.folding_theorem: Occurrencewise scalar folding is exact because pivot count and 77-charge are row functions invariant under H; identical canonical rows have the same divisor, so signed collection commutes with the linear response operator.
source_faithful_kernel.literal_state: (canonical row, signed scaled coefficient, exact response-prefix provenance)
source_faithful_kernel.output_guard: Atomic scalar/count/sample JSON only; never write K19, K20, or K22 row streams.
source_faithful_kernel.pivot_step: enumerate every literal dividing pivot, m=len(pivots), assert coefficient % m == 0, then apply w_child=-w_parent/m to every requested K2/K3/K4 tail

terminality.stronger_K21_to_K24_statement: Every degree d>=21 has anchor sum 24-d in {3,2,1,0}, so every realized K21,K22,K23,K24 response child is terminal.
terminality.universal_K22_proof: For parent degree p=22-s and response shift s, anchor sum is (24-p)-4+(4-s)=24-(p+s)=2<4; hence no four-anchor K0 pivot exists.
